# scripts/ops/New-AvdSandboxBatch.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Builds a sandbox batch from the ready queue items: pins sources to commits, groups items that can share a deployment, prices the groups, checks the caps, and writes batch.json and batch.md to your records (docs/sandbox-runs.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-ItemsPath` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Repo` | string | no |  |  |
| `-IssuesPath` | string | no |  |  |
| `-PinsPath` | string | no |  |  |
| `-DefaultRegion` | string | no | `$env:SPEND_DEFAULT_REGION` | An item in another region must say why. Empty: any region. |
| `-BatchCap` | double | no | `$(if ($env:QUEUE_BATCH_CAP) { [double]$env:QUEUE_BATCH_CAP } else { 10 })` |  |
| `-MonthlyCap` | double | no | `$(if ($env:SPEND_MONTHLY_CAP) { [double]$env:SPEND_MONTHLY_CAP } else { 0 })` |  |
| `-RunCap` | double | no | `$(if ($env:SPEND_RUN_CAP) { [double]$env:SPEND_RUN_CAP } else { 0 })` |  |
| `-MonthToDate` | double | no | `-1` | Month-to-date cost; read from Cost Management when not given. |
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  |  |
| `-RecordsPath` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Local` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-Now` | datetime | no | `(Get-Date)` |  |
| `-RecorderRepo` | string | no |  | Where the run recorder comes from; default: this checkout (its origin and HEAD). |
| `-RecorderSha` | string | no |  |  |
| `-PostIssue` | switch | no |  | Also open a batch issue in -Repo (the GitHub CLI, signed in). |
